assumptions.selection: highest XP/mean cycle seconds among all natively unlocked EXP stages victorious on every seed
assumptions.timing: shipped presentation action frames at the 2x labelled speed; 3 seconds per player COMBAT input plus 6 seconds per receipt/re-entry

currentV4SavedBattlePolicy: Existing version-4 fights settle under the current payout table; their saved actors/initiative are preserved. Versions1/2/3 retain original rewards.
migration: Undefined/1/2 XP curves migrate directly once to curve3 by floor(oldCurrentXP * newNext / oldNext); level, cap, ascension, inventory, ownership and ongoing actors/initiative are preserved; capped XP is zero.

reviewedSourceChange.change: Removed one trailing space on line 196; no semantic change.

provenance.timingReuse: Original all-stage raw fights retain original candidate payouts and curve2. All final chosen fights were repeated under the final payout/curve, and exact actor/input/presentation equality established reuse of the original combat timings. Compact all-stage XP/time comparisons derive final XP rates without rewriting original receipts.

localInputRepresentation.sourceRecovery: All 0.16.7 changed source files were restored over the audited 0.16.6 runtime source. Original assets and historical local git objects were not available.
localInputRepresentation.dbRepresentation: content/db.json is a recovered runtime-only DB with authored annotations removed, matching the server runtime representation. It is not published or substituted for upstream authored content/db.json.
localInputRepresentation.fingerprintScope: These fingerprints identify local reproducible sampling inputs, including that runtime-only DB. They are not raw-byte fingerprints of the complete upstream Git tree.

bookCatchup.character: One new Lv55/phase5 companion on a Lv60 account; final ascension cost still paid.
bookCatchup.limit: Book drops are shared and may be assigned to one companion. Native flower fixtures are independent first claims; repeat claims retain the existing once-per-kind hourly rule. Six claims require at least five hours between first/last opportunities; modeled fight seconds exclude waiting, travel and preparation. Hero count shown conservatively excludes direct bench XP.

limits: Prepared fixed-four-character benchmark, not natural new-account playtime.
Ownership, story gates, legal gear, talents, full entry HP and exact ascension materials are fixtures.
Travel, story, recovery, crafting, mining, equipment/material farming and real human input variance are excluded.
The two routes can take different times; displayed band time is their mean.
Lower winning stages may remain optimal; late Traveler selects stage60 and Isekai stage55, without enemy/stat/growth-structure changes.
